name: Cell's Self Destruct
original_rules: Energy attack doing 12 life cards of damage. If successful, and you don't defeat your opponent, you lose the game. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck, unless your Main Personality is Cell.
modern_rules: Limit 1 per deck unless your Main Personality is Cell. Energy attack costing 2 stages. DAMAGE: 12 life cards. HIT: If you don't defeat your opponent, you lose the game. Banish after use.
icon_prefix: Limit 1 per deck unless your Main Personality is Cell.

name: Cell's Domination Drill
original_rules: Whenever your opponent places a Battleground in play, he discards the top 3 cards from his Life Deck.
modern_rules: Whenever your opponent places a Battleground in play, they discard the top 3 cards of their Life Deck.

name: Kami's Idea
original_rules: Heroes only. If your opponent has more power stages than you, raise your Main Personality to his highest power stage and shuffle the bottom card from your discard pile into your Life Deck. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.
modern_rules: Heroes only. POWER: If your opponent has more stages than you, raise your Main Personality to its highest stage and shuffle the bottom card of your discard pile into your Life Deck. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: He's Safe
original_rules: Gain 5 power stages. Choose 2 cards from your discard pile and shuffle them into your Life Deck.
modern_rules: POWER: Gain 5 stages. Choose 2 cards from your discard pile and shuffle them into your Life Deck.

name: Just Thinking
original_rules: Villains only. Energy attack doing 6 power stages of damage. Costs 1 power stage to perform.
modern_rules: Villains only. Energy attack costing 1 stage. DAMAGE: 6 stages.

name: Land in Pain
original_rules: Discard any Battleground in play. Search all life decks and discard all Battlegrounds.
modern_rules: POWER: Discard any Battleground in play. Search all Life Decks and discard all Battlegrounds.

name: It's All About Time
original_rules: Use when needed. When your opponent reaches 5 or more anger, set his anger and power stages to 0. Limit 1 per deck.
modern_rules: Limit 1 per deck. Use when needed. When your opponent reaches 5 or more anger, set their anger and stages to 0.

name: Trunks Thinking
original_rules: Draw a card. If that card has "Trunks" in the card title, draw another card.
modern_rules: Limit 1 per deck. POWER: Draw a card. If its title contains "Trunks", draw another card.

name: Looking Good
original_rules: Android 18 only. Choose 2 Allies from your Life Deck and put them into play at their highest power stage.
modern_rules: Android 18 only. POWER: Search your Life Deck for 2 Allies and put them into play at their highest stage.

name: Piccolo's Fist Block
original_rules: Your opponent may not use Combat cards for the remainder of Combat.
modern_rules: POWER: Your opponent cannot use Event cards for the rest of this Combat.
